name: media-split
description: Split row: copy with explore links beside a composed scene of floating images and soft glows (the Ursa and integrations scenes). Live: the rows inside #ap-gov-intel on the industry hubs.

title_accent.description: Part of the heading painted with the brand gradient.

reverse.description: Put the scene on the right.

images.description: Scene images. Each: image, x, y, w (% of the 546 by 364 scene); optional float and crop (true/false).

glows.description: Soft glows. Each: x, y, w, h (%) and color (rgb/rgba).

bullets.description: Bullet list under the body copy. Plain strings.

chips.description: Labels pinned over the scene. Each: label, x, y, w (% of the scene); icon (URL) or icon_svg.

scene_width.description: Scene width in px. 0 keeps the default 546.

scene_height.description: Scene height in px. 0 keeps the default 364.

pad_top.description: Section padding above the row in px from 768px up. 0 keeps 40.

pad_bottom.description: Section padding below the row in px from 768px up. 0 keeps 40 (the 2026-10 hub frames: 80 above the first row, 160 under the last).

heading_above.description: Put the eyebrow and heading centred above the row instead of in the copy column.

stack.description: Width at which the layout stacks: 1024px (the hubs) or 900px (the Education hub).
